info.title: Smart Polling Booth Officer Allocation & Notification API
info.description:
REST API of the Smart Polling Booth Officer Allocation and Notification System.

**Authentication** - single-login system (Main Admin).
1. `POST /api/auth/login` with the credentials from `backend/.env` (`ADMIN_USERNAME` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD`).
2. Copy `token` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** and paste it (Swagger adds the `Bearer ` prefix automatically).
4. Mandal-scoped users only ever receive their own Mandal's data; the scope is forced server-side.

**E-mail** - mail is sent through the Gmail API (OAuth2). Connect the mailbox once by opening `/auth/google` in a browser; the refresh token is stored in MongoDB, so sending also works after a server restart.

**Raw JSON** of this specification is served from `/api-docs.json` (importable into Postman / Insomnia).

post.summary: Send the polling-duty SMS for an allocation
post.description: Roles: SUPER_ADMIN, ALLOCATION_OFFICER. Only works for an ALLOCATED allocation that has a booth. The provider is chosen with SMS_PROVIDER (mock | http).

400.description: Allocation is not ALLOCATED or has no booth

Download the allocated-officers list of one Mandal (.xlsx)

get.description: Reports whether the GOOGLE_* variables are set, whether a mailbox is connected, which account it is and where the credentials are stored (env | database | memory). Never returns the tokens themselves.

post.description: Roles: SUPER_ADMIN, ALLOCATION_OFFICER. `text` and/or `html` is required; when both are supplied the message is sent as multipart/alternative. Recipients may be a comma separated string or an array. Answers 503 while no Gmail account is connected (open /auth/google once).

503.description: Gmail not configured or not connected (MAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED | MAIL_NOT_CONNECTED)

post.summary: E-mail the ID-card download link to one allocated officer
post.description: Used by the dashboard Send Mail button. The mail is short: it names the Mandal the officer was allocated to and contains the tokenised link to their Polling Duty ID card PDF - no attachment. Opening the link marks the card as received (idcards collection, `receivedAt`). The officer's `email` field is the recipient. 400 when the officer has no e-mail address, 503 while Gmail is not connected.

400.description: Allocation not ALLOCATED, no booth, or the officer has no e-mail address

503.description: Gmail not configured or not connected

get.summary: Start the Gmail OAuth2 consent flow
get.description: Redirects (302) the browser to the Google consent screen with `access_type=offline` and `prompt=consent`, so a refresh token is always issued. Open this URL once in a browser - it is not a JSON endpoint. The redirect URI must match GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI in backend/.env.

get.summary: OAuth2 callback - stores the refresh token
get.description: Google redirects here after consent. The code is exchanged for tokens, the tokens are persisted in MongoDB (collection `googletokens`) and an HTML result page is returned. After a successful call, `POST /api/mail/send` works - including after a server restart.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by Google when the user denied the request

400.description: Authorization code missing or consent denied (HTML page)

post.summary: E-mail the ID-card download link in bulk
post.description: Select recipients with `allocationIds`, with `mandal` (every ALLOCATED officer of that Mandal) or both. The response always contains a per-officer result list, so one failure never stops the run. Maximum 100 recipients per request.

mandal.description: Every ALLOCATED officer of this Mandal

limit.description: Safety cap when selecting by Mandal

502.description: Gmail rejected at least one message

503.description: Gmail not configured or not connected

post.description: Sends a test message to the connected mailbox, to GMAIL_FROM, or to the `to` address supplied in the body. The quickest way to verify the connection from Swagger.

503.description: Gmail not configured or not connected

post.description: Deletes the stored GoogleToken document. A refresh token pinned through GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN in .env is not removed.

Forbidden.description: The signed-in role may not perform this action

Conflict.description: Duplicate key (e.g. Officer ID / Booth ID already exists)

XlsxDownload.description: Excel workbook (.xlsx) download. The file name is returned in the Content-Disposition header, which is exposed through Access-Control-Expose-Headers. This endpoint is best called from the dashboard or with a saved file, e.g. `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -OJ http://localhost:5000/api/reports/officers-excel`.
